title: Free time at home
about: What people do in their free time at home: watching TV and films, listening to music, hobbies like cooking and gardening, reading, and having friends round.

parts.title: Common mistakes
parts.note: Телевізор дивляться — watch TV, а не see TV. Радіо слухають — listen to the radio: з to і з the. Hear the radio або listen the radio так не кажуть.

rows: hear the radio · listen the radio

items.pattern: watch TV · watch sth on TV · like watching TV
items.meaning: look at programmes on a television
items.example: We **watch TV** after dinner.
more: My little brother **watches TV** before school.
Don't **watch TV** too late. You've got school tomorrow.
items.watchOut: Дивитися телевізор — watch TV, зазвичай без the. See TV не кажуть. По телевізору — on TV: a film on TV.

items.pattern: watch / see a film · see a film at the cinema
items.meaning: look at a film from the start to the end
items.example: Did you **see** the new film about dinosaurs?
more: We **watched a film** about penguins at school.
Let's **see a film** at the cinema on Saturday.
items.watchOut: Про фільм можна сказати і watch, і see: Did you see / watch that film? А телевізор — тільки watch TV. Фільм — a film (UK), a movie (US).

items.pattern: a TV / radio programme · a programme about sth
items.meaning: a show on TV or the radio
items.example: There's a great **programme** about sharks on TV tonight.
more: My mum likes cooking **programmes**.
What's your favourite radio **programme**?
items.watchOut: Британською — programme, американською — program. Канал — a channel: «перемкни на іншу програму» — change the channel.

items.pattern: watch a DVD · on DVD
items.meaning: watch a film from a disc at home
items.example: It's cold outside, so let's **watch a DVD** at home.
more: Grandma has got lots of old cartoons on **DVD**.
We **watched a DVD** of my sister's school concert.
items.watchOut: DVD читається буквами: /ˌdiː viː ˈdiː/. Подивитися фільм на диску — watch a DVD; фільм вийшов на диску — the film is on DVD.

items.pattern: listen to music / sb / sth · like listening to music
items.meaning: hear music and pay attention to it
items.example: I **listen to music** when I do my homework.
more: Dad **listens to music** in the car.
Do you like **listening to music** on your phone?
items.watchOut: Слухати щось — listen TO sth: listen to music, listen to me. Hear — просто чути: I can hear a bird.

items.pattern: listen to the radio · on the radio
items.meaning: hear programmes or music from a radio
items.example: Grandpa **listens to the radio** every morning.
more: I heard this song **on the radio**.
Is there any news **on the radio**?
items.watchOut: Радіо — з the: listen to the radio, on the radio. Не listen the radio і не hear the radio. А телевізор зазвичай без the: watch TV, on TV.

items.pattern: a pair of headphones · put on / wear headphones
items.meaning: things you put on or in your ears to listen to music alone
items.example: Please use your **headphones**. I'm trying to read.
more: I left my **headphones** on the bus.
She always wears **headphones** when she goes running.
items.watchOut: Headphones — завжди множина: my headphones are new (не is). Одна пара — a pair of headphones.

items.pattern: play video games · play a video game
items.meaning: play games on a computer, TV or phone
items.example: My cousins **play video games** every Saturday morning.
more: You can **play video games** after your homework.
Which **video game** do you like best?
items.watchOut: Грати в гру — play a game, без in: play video games. Не play in video games.

items.pattern: download sth (from the Internet)
items.meaning: copy music, films or other things from the Internet onto your phone or computer
items.example: I **downloaded** some songs for the long car trip.
more: Can we **download** this film to watch on the plane?
This book is free to **download**.
items.watchOut: Скачати з інтернету — download from the Internet. Upload — навпаки: вивантажити в інтернет.

items.pattern: on the Internet · from the Internet · use the Internet
items.meaning: the network that connects computers and phones all over the world
items.example: I found a pancake recipe **on the Internet**.
more: Grandma learned to use **the Internet** last year.
There's no **Internet** at our country house.
items.watchOut: В інтернеті — on the Internet (не in). Зазвичай з the: the Internet. Online — «онлайн, в інтернеті», без the і без in.

items.pattern: chat to / with sb online
items.meaning: talk with friends by writing messages on the Internet
items.example: After dinner, I **chat to my friends online** for half an hour.
more: My sister **chats online** with her pen friend in Canada.
We **chatted online** about our plans for the weekend.
items.watchOut: Chat to sb (UK) або chat with sb. Online — без in і без the: chat online, не in online.

items.pattern: like / love cooking · do the cooking
items.meaning: making food
items.example: My dad loves **cooking**. He makes great pizza.
more: Who does the **cooking** in your family?
**Cooking** with my grandma is fun.
items.watchOut: Cook — це і «готувати», і «кухар». А cooker — плита, не кухар!

items.pattern: like gardening · do some gardening
items.meaning: working in a garden: planting and looking after flowers and plants
items.example: In spring, Mum does a lot of **gardening**.
more: I don't like **gardening**. It's too dirty!
Grandpa does some **gardening** every morning.
items.watchOut: Вимова: /ˈɡɑːdnɪŋ/, наголос на першому складі; «e» майже не чути. Garden у британській англійській — і сад, і город біля будинку.

items.pattern: grow flowers / vegetables / fruit
items.meaning: put plants in the ground and look after them so they get bigger
items.example: My aunt **grows flowers** on her balcony.
more: We **grow** tomatoes in our garden.
These **flowers** need a lot of sun.
items.watchOut: Вирощувати рослини — grow sth. Grow up — це про людей: дорослішати (I grew up in Odesa).

items.pattern: fresh vegetables · grow / eat vegetables
items.meaning: plants we eat, like carrots, potatoes and onions
items.example: Eat your **vegetables**. They're good for you.
more: We buy fresh **vegetables** at the market.
Carrots are my favourite **vegetables**.
items.watchOut: Вимова: /ˈvedʒtəblz/ — три склади, наголос на першому: VEJ-te-bls. Не ve-ge-TA-bles.

items.pattern: read a lot · read books / comics / a newspaper
items.meaning: read very often
items.example: My brother **reads a lot**. He always has a book in his bag.
more: I **read a lot** in the summer holidays.
What do you **read** at the weekend?
items.watchOut: У стверджувальному реченні зазвичай кажуть a lot: I read a lot. I read much звучить неприродно.

items.pattern: a novel · read a novel · a novel about sth
items.meaning: a long book with a story that a writer made up
items.example: I'm reading a **novel** about a girl and her horse.
more: It's a long **novel**, but I finished it in a week.
My English teacher wrote a **novel** for teenagers.
items.watchOut: Хибний друг: a novel — це роман (довга книжка), а не новела. Коротке оповідання — a short story. Новина — news.

items.pattern: read comics · a comic
items.meaning: magazines or books with stories told in pictures
items.example: My little brother loves **comics** about superheroes.
more: I bought two **comics** at the station.
Dad kept all his old **comics** from school.
items.watchOut: Один комікс — a comic (UK) або a comic book.

items.pattern: a book about sth · books about nature / animals / history
items.meaning: a book on a subject
items.example: I got a **book about** space for my birthday.
more: Have you got any **books about** horses?
This **book about** Japan has beautiful photos.
items.watchOut: Книжка про щось — a book about sth. For — для кого: a book for children.

items.pattern: a magazine about sth · a music / sport magazine
items.meaning: a thin book with photos and stories that comes out every week or month
items.example: My mum reads a **magazine about** gardening.
more: I buy a football **magazine** every month.
There's an interview with my favourite singer in this **magazine**.
items.watchOut: Хибний друг: a magazine — журнал, а не магазин! Магазин — a shop. Вимова: /ˌmæɡəˈziːn/, наголос на останньому складі.

items.pattern: read a / the newspaper · in the newspaper
items.meaning: large thin pages with news that come out every day or week
items.example: Grandpa reads the **newspaper** with his breakfast.
more: There's a photo of our school **in the newspaper**!
Do you read a **newspaper** on your phone?
items.watchOut: У газеті — in the newspaper (не on). Коротко кажуть a paper: Have you seen today's paper?

items.pattern: have sb round · have friends round
items.meaning: ask friends to come to your house or flat
items.example: Can I **have friends round** on Friday?
more: We often **have friends round** to play board games.
My parents **had** their old school **friends round** last night.
items.watchOut: Запросити друзів до себе — have friends round (UK) або have friends over. Порядок слів: have + хто + round.

items.pattern: have sb to dinner / lunch
items.meaning: ask people to come and eat a meal at your home
items.example: On Sunday we're **having** our neighbours **to dinner**.
more: My grandparents often **have** the whole family **to lunch**.
We **had friends to dinner** and made pasta.
items.watchOut: На вечерю — to dinner, без a і без the. Також кажуть invite sb to dinner / for dinner, але не on dinner.

items.pattern: come to stay (with sb)
items.meaning: come to your home and sleep there for one night or more
items.example: My cousin is **coming to stay** for a week in July.
more: Grandma **comes to stay** with us every Christmas.
Can my friend **come to stay** on Saturday night?
items.watchOut: Come to stay — гість ночує у тебе. Come round / come over — приходить ненадовго, без ночівлі.

items.phrase: talk to sb on the phone
items.pattern: talk to sb on the phone · be on the phone
items.meaning: speak to someone using a phone
items.example: I **talk to** my aunt in Spain **on the phone** every week.
more: Mum is **on the phone**. Please be quiet.
My sister **talks on the phone** for hours!
items.watchOut: По телефону — on the phone, не in the phone. Розмовляти з кимось — talk to sb, з to.

items.pattern: (just) do nothing
items.meaning: not do any work or activities, just rest
items.example: On Sunday afternoon I just **do nothing**.
more: It's nice to **do nothing** on the first day of the holidays.
We **did nothing** all morning, and it was great.
items.watchOut: В англійській одне заперечення: I do nothing або I don't do anything. Не I don't do nothing.

items.pattern: have a sleep (after lunch) · have a nap
items.meaning: sleep for a short time in the day
items.example: The baby **has a sleep** every afternoon.
more: I'm tired. I'm going to **have a sleep** before the party.
Our cat **has a sleep** on the sofa after breakfast.
items.watchOut: Подрімати вдень — have a sleep або have a nap, а не make a sleep. Go to sleep — заснути.

warmup.uk: Я щовечора дивлюся телевізор з родиною.
warmup.q: I ___ TV with my family every evening.
warmup.explain: Дивитися телевізор — watch TV. See TV не кажуть.

warmup.uk: Мій тато слухає радіо в машині.
warmup.q: My dad ___ the radio in the car.
warmup.explain: Слухати радіо — listen to the radio, обов'язково з to.

warmup.q: Mum is reading a ___ about cooking.
warmup.explain: Журнал — a magazine. Shop і store — це магазин.

warmup.q: I love reading ___ — long books with exciting stories.
warmup.explain: Роман — a novel. Хибний друг: це не новела.

warmup.uk: Моя подруга приїде до нас погостювати на вихідні.
warmup.q: My friend is coming to ___ for the weekend.
warmup.explain: Приїхати погостювати з ночівлею — come to stay.

warmup.q: Grandpa often ___ a sleep after lunch.
warmup.explain: Поспати вдень — have a sleep: Grandpa has a sleep.

warmup.uk: Ми часто запрошуємо друзів у гості.
warmup.explain: «В гості» дослівно не перекладають: have friends round.

warmup.q: We ___ vegetables at our country house.

A.q: Shh! I'm ___ to a song on the radio.
A.explain: Слухати щось — listen to sth. Hear і watch не вживають з to.

A.q: Turn on the TV. My favourite ___ starts in five minutes.
My brother is sleeping, so I'm using my ___.
A.explain: Щоб нікому не заважати, слухають музику в навушниках — headphones.

B.q: My mum likes ___. She makes soup every Sunday.
I want to ___ this song from the Internet.
My sister and I ___ to our cousins online on Sundays.
B.explain: Спілкуватися онлайн — chat to sb online.

C.q: My aunt writes long ___. Each one has 400 pages.
C.explain: Довга книжка з вигаданою історією — a novel (роман).

C.q: My little sister can't read well, so she likes ___ with lots of pictures.
Dad reads the ___ every morning to find out the news.
C.explain: Новини читають у газеті — a newspaper.

D.q: My best friend sometimes comes to ___ at our flat for the weekend.
D.explain: Come to stay — приїжджати в гості з ночівлею.

D.q: I'm going to ___ nothing this weekend. I just want to rest!
I ___ to my grandma on the phone every Sunday.
D.explain: Розмовляти з кимось — talk to sb. Say і tell так не вживають.

topics: a snowy day in the holidays

example.title: A rainy Saturday
example.uk:
У суботу йшов дощ, тож ми залишилися вдома. Зранку тато слухав радіо, а мама куховарила. Я годину спілкувалася з друзями онлайн.

Після обіду дідусь поспав на дивані. Мій брат грав у відеоігри, а я читала комікс про хороброго кота.

Увечері ми запросили друзів у гості. Ми дивилися фільм на диску і їли піцу. Це був чудовий лінивий день!
example.en:
It was raining on Saturday, so we stayed at home. In the morning, Dad [[listened to the radio|a6]] and Mum did some [[cooking|b5]]. I [[chatted to my friends online|b4]] for an hour.

After lunch, Grandpa [[had a sleep|d6]] on the sofa. My brother [[played video games|b1]], and I read a [[comic|c3]] about a brave cat.

In the evening, we [[had friends round|d1]]. We [[watched a DVD|a4]] and ate pizza. It was a lovely, lazy day!
